root_cause.text: In the `bnxt_rx_xdp()` function, the XDP_TX case unconditionally cleared event flags (e.g., `BNXT_TX_EVENT`) at entry rather than only clearing `BNXT_RX_EVENT` after a successful transmit, which could erase a pending `BNXT_TX_EVENT` flag from a previous iteration and lead to a TX ring doorbell never being rung when the TX ring was full.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "In particular, if BNXT_TX_EVENT is set earlier indicating some XDP_TX packets are ready and pending, it will be cleared if it is XDP_TX action again. Normally, we will set BNXT_TX_EVENT again when we successfully call __bnxt_xmit_xdp(). But if the TX ring has no more room, the flag will not be set. This will cause the TX producer to be ahead but the driver will not hit the TX doorbell." The patch removes the lines `*event &= BNXT_TX_CMP_EVENT;` and `*event = BNXT_AGG_EVENT;` and adds `*event &= ~BNXT_RX_EVENT;` only after a successful transmit, confirming the fix.
